name: swe
label: Staff Software Engineer
summary: Staff-level software engineer with 20+ years of experience building distributed systems in Python, Rust, Go, and Scala on AWS. Shipped production services handling 13k+ QPS, data architectures processing hundreds of thousands of requests per second, and a C++ gRPC bridge validating autonomous driving systems in simulation. Deep current practice in agentic AI: production agentic workflows for code review and documentation, LLM agent runtimes, and semantic memory systems. Brings SRE-grade operational rigor to software design.

highlights: Architected and maintained a C++ gRPC bridge connecting the virtual driver stack to a vendor scenario engine, enabling simulated scenario validation of the autonomous driving system
Designed agentic AI workflows adopted team-wide: automated multi-model PR review, self-updating documentation via stacked PRs, and AI skills for production-readiness and observability review
Managed Torc's simulation infrastructure, built on AWS primitives and processing over 50k simulation scenarios daily
Improved operational uptime from 90% to 99%
Achieved ~$30k/month (~22%) AWS cost savings through optimization
Mentored engineers on infrastructure and operational best practices
Embedded hands-on with the 3-engineer team behind a Tier-0 service depended on by all of MuleSoft, delivering a security and compliance uplift to corporate standards under deadline pressure
Directed multi-year migration of MuleSoft Control Plane from self-managed Kubernetes to AWS EKS with zero downtime, improving post-migration uptime to 99.99%
Drove adoption of safe change practices and blue/green deployment
Led technical development for an organization of ~80 engineers, directly mentoring 15-20 and guiding career growth across the org
Led migration from New Relic to Salesforce internal monitoring platforms across production environments
Identified and documented multiple opportunities for multi-million dollar cost savings
Reviewed major code changes for ML pipelines, improving performance and maintainability
Improved ingestion performance for on-prem ML classifiers by several orders of magnitude
Developed Terraform modules codifying best practices for EKS autoscaling and node termination
Led development of system for automated provisioning of trusted AWS accounts with verifiable security properties for use across Salesforce
Executed lossless migration of data collection architecture handling hundreds of thousands req/s
Led transition from legacy CI to new CI/CD platforms with zero data loss
Introduced Embedded Platform Engineering model to unify platform and product teams
Guided hybrid deployment models emphasizing cloud coherence and shared tooling
Designed and deployed distributed web services in Scala + Play! handling 13k QPS in production
Re-architected Java and Python systems for 10x throughput using open-source components
Built real-time data collection and websockets services supporting 2k data points/sec per process
Scaled Kafka clusters 50% while reducing costs 11%
Architected reorganization of DevOps and Platform teams to support scale; introduced patterns adopted org-wide

referencesAdd.reference: Grey's years of experience shine through in their approach to problem-solving: a structured approach that is not only easy to review but instructive - clear documentation of the problem first, succinct description of the what, why, and how in each unit/module, and PRs that flow very well. Their approach is almost like a Software Engineering textbook case-study.
